rubric.description: Analyzes only Alternative Offense Z, which the approved defense position and ruling actually raise, and does not inventory conceivable offenses.
States that the recording does not resolve Conduct C, does not admit C occurred, and maps the possible conduct to Element Z1.
Explains at element level why the unresolved fact does not supply probable or arguable probable cause, or records the exact filing-critical GAP preventing that answer.
